label: One pass of tentative moves
subgoals: Pick the highest-gain free cell whose move keeps balance
Move and lock it, then update neighbour gains
Record each move's gain until no free cell can move

label: Committing the best prefix
subgoals: Accumulate the gains in move order
Keep the prefix with the largest cumulative gain and undo the rest
Start a new pass unless the best gain was zero

label: Strengths and limits
subgoals: Count O(P) work per pass with buckets
Recognize that single-cell moves cannot shift whole clusters
Combine FM with multilevel coarsening to escape local minima
